content: Řeḥṣaret n Samarya d umenɣi ɣar Afiq
Binhadad, ajeǧid n Aram, issmun marra řɛeskar nnes. Tuɣa akides tnayen u-třatin n ijeǧiden s iysan d ikarruten. Netta igeɛɛed, inneḍ i Samarya u immneɣ akides.
Xenni issekk netta ireqqasen ɣar Axab, ajeǧid n Israil, daxeř di tendint.
Inna as: “Ammu i iqqar Bin-Hadad: ‘Nnuqart nnec d wureɣ nnec inu. Uřa d timɣarin nnec d iḥenjiren nnec icewwaren, aqa aten inu.’”
Ajeǧid n Israil yarra-dd xas, inna: “Am mammec tennid, a sidi inu ajeǧid. Necc nnec s marra min ɣari.”
Ireqqasen usin-dd ict n twařa nneɣnit, nnan: “Ammu issiweř Binhadad, inna: ‘Necc jjiɣ ad ac inin: Ittxeṣṣa ad ayi tewced nnuqart d wureɣ nnec d temɣarin nnec d iḥenjiren nnec!,

maca tiwecca ɣar řweqt-a ad ssekkeɣ imsexxaren inu ɣarek, maḥend ad arzun di taddart nnec u di tudrin n imsexxaren nnec. Ad imsar belli nitni ad ṭṭfen marra min xak iɛizzen di tiṭṭawin nnec s ifassen nsen, ad t awyen.’”

Xenni iřaɣa ujeǧid n Israil x marra imɣaren n temmurt, inna: “Snem xenni u xzarem aqa wanita inwa řɣar, maɣar tuɣa issekk-dd ɣari qbeř, maḥend ad iksi timɣarin inu d iḥenjiren inu d nnuqart inu d wureɣ inu u necc war d as t qḍiɛeɣ.”
Marra imɣaren d marra řgens nnan as: “War ɣares ttesři u war d as ttic ttesriḥ!”

Xenni inna i ireqqasen n Binhadad: “Inim i sidi inu ajeǧid: ‘Marra umi i tessekked amsexxar nnec ɣar umezwaru ad t ggeɣ, maca tamesřact-a war zemmareɣ ad t ggeɣ.’” Ffɣen ireqqasen uca iwyen as-dd awař-a.
Xas uca issekk Binhadad ɣares, inna: “Ad ayi ggen irebbiten ammu u ad arnin ɛad ktar, mařa taɛejjajt n Samarya tqedd, ḥima ad teccur uru n ifassen n marra řgens i yuyuren deg iṣuraf inu!”
Yarra-dd ujeǧid n Israil, inna: “Inim as: ‘Wenni ibeysen abyas, war ittcenneɛ ixef nnes am wenni t issarsen.’”
Umi isřa i wawař-a, am tuɣa isess ak-d ijeǧiden deg iqiḍan, aqa inna i imsexxaren nnes: “Sbeddem ixef nwem!” U nitni sswejden ixef nsen i umenɣi ḍidd i tendint.
U xzar ijj n unabi yusa-dd ɣar Axab, ajeǧid n Israil, inna: “Ammu i issiweř SIDI: ‘Ma tᵉttwařid cek řɣaci-ya ameqqran? Xzar ass-a Necc ad t wceɣ deg ufus nnec, ḥima ad tessned aqa Necc d SIDI.’”
Uca Axab inna: “Zi man wen?” Netta inna: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘S imsexxaren n řḥukkam n lɛamalat.’” U netta inna: “Man wen i ɣa ibdan amenɣi?” Inna netta: “D cek!”
Xas uca isedd netta imsexxaren n řḥukkam n lɛamalat. Tuɣa aten di mitayen u-tnayen u-třatin. Isedd awarni asen marra řgens. Marra ayt n Israil, tuɣa aten di sebɛa-ařaf n yeryazen.
Ffɣen nitni ɣar wazal. Binhadad tuɣa iscar deg iqiḍan, netta d ijeǧiden, tnayen u-třatin n ijeǧiden i d as iwcin afus.
Imsexxaren n řḥukkam n lɛamalat ffɣen-dd d imezwura zi Samarya. Binhadad tuɣa issekk ca n ibergagen u nitni xebbaren as, nnan: “Aqa iryazen ffɣen-dd zi Samarya.”
Netta inna: “Mařa nitni ffɣen-dd i řehna, ṭṭfem ten ddaren u mařa nitni ffɣen-dd i umenɣi, ṭṭfem ten ɛawed ddaren!”
Ffɣen-dd imsexxaren n řḥukkam n lɛamalat zi tendint ak-d řɛeskar i dd-yusin awarni asen.
Kuř aryaz iɣřeb x weɣrim nnes ařami arewřen ayt n Aram u Israil iḍfar i-ten, maca Binhadad, ajeǧid n Aram, injem x uyis ak-d ca n imnayen.
Xenni iffeɣ uřa d ajeǧid n Israil u netta iɣřeb x yeysan d ikarruten n umenɣi ařami igga as ict n tecti d tameqqrant i Aram.
Xenni yusa-dd unabi ɣar ujeǧid n Israil, inna as: “Uyur, mḥeḍ ixef nnec. Ssen u xzar min ɣarek ad t tegged, maɣar ɣar ubeddu n useggʷas n jdid ad xak iffeɣ ujeǧid n Aram twařa nneɣni.
Imsexxaren n ujeǧid n Aram nnan as: “AREBBI nsen d ijj n arebbi n idurar, x uya tuɣa jehden xaneɣ. Mařa neccin nemmneɣ akidsen di řwaṭa, xenni ad xasen nejhed nican!
Egg min iqqar wawař-a: Kkes kuř ijj zeg ijeǧiden zeg wemcan nnes u ggem lwulat deg wemcan nsen.

Smun ammu ijj n řɛeskar am řɛeskar nni tweddared, s yeysan am yeysan nni u s ikarruten am ikarruten nni, uca ejj aneɣ akidsen nemmneɣ di řwaṭa. Uct mařa xenni neccin war xasen nejhid!” U netta isřa ɣarsen uca amenni i igga.
Ɣar ubeddu n useggʷas n jdid, imsar, aqa Binhadad isedd Aram. Iffeɣ ɣar Afiq i umenɣi ak-d Israil.

Uřa d ayt n Israil ttwasedden. Wcin asen řeɛweč u nitni ffɣen i umsagar akidsen. Ayt n Israil wtin iqiḍan nsen ajemmaḍ nsen am tnayen n tḥimriwin timeẓyanin n iɣayḍen. Inni n Aram maca ɛemmaren tammurt.

Yusa-dd ɣarsen weryaz n SIDI, issiweř ak-d ujeǧid n Israil, inna: “Ammu i issiweř SIDI: ‘Minzi inni n Aram innan: SIDI d ijj n arebbi n idurar, war iǧi d ijj n arebbi n tseǧyin!’, x uya i ɣa wceɣ řɣaci-ya ameqqran deg ufus nnec, ḥima kenniw ad tɛeqřem, aqa Necc d SIDI.”
Tuɣa wtin iqiḍan nsen sebɛa n wussan arendad n wayawya. Deg wass wiss sebɛa, imsar, aqa ikkar umenɣi. Deg ijj n wass nɣin ayt n Israil myat-ařef n yeryazen x iḍaren zi Aram.

Inni iqqimen arewřen ɣar tendint n Afiq uca řḥiḍ iwḍa x sebɛa u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen, nni tuɣa iqqimen. Uřa Binhadad tuɣa yarweř uca yudef ɣar tendint, yuyur zeg ijj n wexxam ɣar ijj n wexxam nneɣni.

Xenni nnan as imsexxaren nnes: “Xzar, neccin nesřa, aqa ijeǧiden n taddart n Israil d ijeǧiden daysen tamexsiwt icewwaren. Ejj aneɣ ad nebyes s txuncay n wecḍan ɣar webyas u s iseɣwan ɣar izeǧifen nneɣ uca ad neffeɣ ɣar ujeǧid n Israil. Ad taɣ ad cek yejj ad teddared.”

Nitni beysen s txuncay n wecḍan u ggin iseɣwan ɣar izeǧifen nsen uca ammu dd-usin nitni ɣar ujeǧid n Israil, nnan: “Amsexxar nnec Binhadad inna: ‘Ejj ad iddar řeɛmar inu!’” U netta yarra-dd: “Ma netta iddar ɛad? Netta d uma!”

Iryazen fehmen aqa man aya d ict n řeɛřamet teṣbeḥ, uca arzun deɣya x ca, ma aqa man aya nican, uca nnan: “Umac Binhadad ...” Uca netta inna: “Asem-dd, awyem t-i-dd danita.” Xenni iffeɣ Binhadad ɣares u netta issenya t deg ukarru.

Inna as Binhadad: “Tineddam nni tuɣa iṭṭef baba zi babac, ad tent arreɣ. Iwa, egg i yixef nnec dcurat i tsebbabt di Dimacq am mammec igga baba dcurat di Samarya.” Uca Axab inna: “Necc ad ac arxuɣ x ijj n řɛahd.” U netta iqqen akides ijj n řɛahd uca yarxu as.
Anabi iwebbex Axab
Ijj n weryaz zeg ayt n inabiyyen inna i jjar nnes s wawař n SIDI: “Wwet ayi!” Aryaz yugi maca ad t iwwet.
Inna as netta: “Minzi cek war tesřid ɣar tmijja n SIDI, xzar, mɣir cek ad xafi teffɣed, ad cek ineɣ ijj n weyrad.” Umi xas yuyur, iřqef i-t ijj n weyrad u wanita inɣa i-t.
Xenni yufa ijj n weryaz nneɣni, inna: “Wwet ayi!” Aryaz nni iwta i-t ammu, ařami t iyzem.
Yuyur unabi, ibedd ɣar webrid i umeřqi ak-d ujeǧid. Issnuffar ixef nnes s ijj n řecfen x tiṭṭawin nnes.

Umi dd-iɛdu ujeǧid, imsar, aqa iřaɣa i ujeǧid, inna: “Amsexxar nnec tuɣa iffeɣ ɣar řwesṭ n umenɣi. Uca xzar, aqa din ijj weryaz yusa-dd ɣar uɣezdis, yiwi ayi-dd ijj n weryaz, inna: ‘Ḥḍa aryaz-a, maca mařa iweddar ɣar useddi n řɛeskar, ad yiři řeɛmar nnec deg wemcan nnes niɣ ad txeǧṣed ict n talint n nnuqart.’
Řami tuɣa ittceɣeř umsexxar nnec da d diha, imsar, aqa war din iqqim ɛad.” Inna as ujeǧid n Israil: “Wa d řḥukm nnec, tewtid t s yixef nnec!”
Netta ikkes deɣya řecfen x tiṭṭawin nnes, uca iɛqeř i-t ujeǧid n Israil, aqa-t d ijj zeg inabiyyen.
Netta inna as: “Ammu i issiweř SIDI: ‘Minzi cek tejjid aryaz nni ḥarrmeɣ necc i uteḥḥi ad injem zeg ufus nnec, ad yiři řeɛmar nnec deg wemcan n řeɛmar nnes u řgens nnec deg wemcan n řgens nnes.”
Ajeǧid n Israil yuyur s řxaḍar ixsaren d ixeyyiqen ɣar taddart uca yusa-dd ɣar Samarya.
